item.title: As told to Parliament (February 12, 2026): India’s AI workforce set to double to 1.25 million in 3 years
item.description: India's AI workforce is set to double to 1.25 million by 2027, driven by a 15% annual growth rate, as reported to Parliament. This expansion is expected to boost job creation in data science and AI-related fields.

item.title: Trump has scrapped the long-standing legal basis for tackling climate emissions
item.description: Trump's EPA has repealed the 2009 endangerment finding, removing the legal basis for regulating greenhouse gases. This decision undermines Obama-era climate policies and is expected to lead to extensive legal battles, complicating future federal climate action.

item.title: Menopause, hormones and the brain: how hormone therapy could help protect against Alzheimer’s
item.description: Hormone therapy during menopause may help protect against Alzheimer's by activating protective proteins and reducing inflammation. While not a guaranteed prevention, it offers a promising tool alongside a healthy lifestyle to support brain health and reduce dementia risk.
